caption:
Raising the ad budget after a slow month feels like the fix.

It isn't.

More leads just hit the same slow follow-up. Industry lead-response research shows most service businesses take longer than an hour to answer a new lead, and teams that respond within five minutes can roughly double their close rate.

Pull your last 20 leads. Time how long each one waited for a first response. That number shows you where the next dollar actually needs to go.
